key_insight: CATCH uses continuous adversarial training to make LLMs more consistently honest, and this honesty transfers across different benchmarks without sacrificing much utility.
engineering_relevance: For deployed LLM systems, CATCH offers a practical training recipe to reduce deceptive responses in high-stakes settings while preserving model usefulness.
method: Train the model toward an honest answer and away from a dishonest one.
Use only hundreds of self-reporting targets to learn honesty behavior.
Add novel utility data to better preserve general capabilities during training.
evidence_signal: The approach was evaluated on Llama-3.3-70B-Instruct and Qwen3-3.6-27B, showing reduced dishonesty on MASK, more confessions in Among Us, and better hidden-behavior discovery in AuditBench.
watch_item: The method’s effectiveness depends on the quality and coverage of the self-reporting targets and utility data, so behavior may not transfer equally well to all deployment contexts.
paper_title: CAT-alyzing Honesty: Continuous Adversarial Training for Transferable LLM Honesty
